stem: Calculate the area scale factor of the transformation with matrix $A=\begin{pmatrix}2&0\\0&3\end{pmatrix}$.
Calculate the area scale factor of the transformation with matrix $A=\begin{pmatrix}0&-1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}$.
Calculate the area scale factor of the transformation with matrix $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&2\end{pmatrix}$.
Calculate the area scale factor of the transformation with matrix $A=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}$.
Calculate the $(1,2)$ entry of the inverse of the combined matrix $CD$, where $C=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ and $D=\begin{pmatrix}0&-1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}$.
Calculate the determinant of $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&2\\2&4\end{pmatrix}$ and hence decide whether its transformation has an inverse. Enter the determinant.
State what $\det A=0$ means for a two-dimensional transformation.

options.A: Orientation reverses but area is unchanged.
options.B: Areas collapse to zero and no inverse exists.
options.C: Areas are unchanged and the inverse is $A$.

stem: Find the first coordinate of the image of $(1,2)^T$ under $T=\begin{pmatrix}2&-1\\3&4\end{pmatrix}$.
